name: Hai Pham

bio.statement: The Oregon Legislature page says Pham spent fourteen years as a pediatric dentist serving children and families in Washington County.
bio.excerpt: After spending the past fourteen years as a pediatric dentist serving children and their families in Washington County

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Pham lists his occupation as state representative and pediatric dentist, with a background as a small business owner and pediatric dentistry chair at Randall Children's Hospital.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Representative, Pediatric Dentist Occupational Background: Small Business Owner; Pediatric Dentistry Chair, Randall Children's Hospital

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 55

bio.statement: Pham lists a BS from Oregon State and a DMD from OHSU.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: Oregon State, BS; OHSU, DMD

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 55

bio.statement: Pham lists the Governor's Children Cabinet and the Oregon Board of Dentistry.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Governor’s Children Cabinet, Oregon Board of Dentistry

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 55

positions.statement: In a 2022 Ballotpedia candidate survey, Pham said medical and dental coverage for all is a right, not a privilege (statement dates from his first campaign).
positions.excerpt: Medical and dental coverage for all is a right, not a privilege.

source.publisher: Ballotpedia

positions.statement: Pham says he will continue to reduce the high costs of living.
positions.excerpt: Reduce the high costs of living so that every family has the opportunity to build generational wealth.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 55

positions.statement: Pham says he will ensure every neighborhood is a safe place to live, work and raise a family.
positions.excerpt: Ensure that every neighborhood is a safe place to live, work, and raise a family.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 55

positions.statement: Pham says he will build an accessible and affordable healthcare system.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 55

positions.statement: Pham says he will invest in jobs and grow the regional economy.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 55

positions.statement: Pham says he will defend civil rights and uphold democracy.

positions.statement: Pham's campaign website says he wants all Oregon residents to have high quality education.

source.publisher: Hai Pham campaign website (Policy Priorities)

voting_record.statement: KOIN reported (early 2023) that Pham was among the sponsors of HB 3090, a bill on flavored tobacco sales.
voting_record.excerpt: as well as and Rep. Hai Pham, D-Hillsboro.

source.publisher: KOIN
